theorems.name: Submission.cmcdtsr_cube_cover
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (x : Euclid P), ∃ Z : Finset (Fin P → ℤ), (∀ z ∈ Z, ∀ i, (z i : ℝ) ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ z i + 1) ∧ ∀ᶠ y : Euclid P in 𝓝 x, ∃ z ∈ Z, ∀ i, (z i : ℝ) ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ z i + 1
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
